title: AuralSong Refinement
description: User-authored per-region refinement overlay applied on top of features/notes.mid for one instrument. The game's chartLoader applies these regions as a destructive overlay: any base notes whose t_on falls within [t_start, t_end) are removed and replaced by the region's notes. Stored at features/refinement.<instrument>.json (one file per instrument).

version.description: Semantic version of this refinement file format. Same major version is forward-compatible; different major = unsupported.

instrument.description: Which instrument's track this refinement applies to.

session_id.description: Optional opaque identifier for the editing session that produced this file.

started_at.description: When the user began this refinement session.

regions.description: Refined regions. Disjoint in time (no overlapping [t_start, t_end) intervals); the loader does not enforce this but tests + UI should.

t_off.description: Offset time in seconds (song-time). Must be > t_on.

id.description: Stable region identifier (e.g. 'verse1-bar3-octave'); should round-trip across re-imports.

confidence.description: System confidence in the region's auto_picked candidate (0..1).

accepted_candidate.description: Candidate id (from refine_candidates.json) that the user accepted. Provenance only; the loader trusts `notes`.

auto_accepted.description: True if accepted automatically (confidence above threshold) without explicit user action.

notes.description: Materialized note list for this region after the accepted candidate is applied. The loader uses ONLY this array; refine_candidates.json is not consulted at runtime.
